newsitem.title: USA: Western Atlas to acquire United Barcode.
newsitem.headline: Western Atlas to acquire United Barcode.

text.p: Western Atlas Inc said Thursday it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire United Barcode Industries, an automated data collection and distribution company based in Sweden.
Financial details of the deal were undisclosed.
In a statement, Western Atlas said it will combine United Barcode with the operations of its Intermec unit.

United Barcode, which generated $100 million in revenues in 1996, is developing thermal label printers and scanners using charge coupled devices technology, an alternative to laser scanners in many applications.

"Our recently completed acquisition of Norand Corp and the purchase of UBI move us into the leading position in this rapidly growing industry," said Alton Brann, Western Atlas chief executive officer.

Based in Everett, Wash., Intermec designs and manufactures a broad line of data collection hardware, software, services and label supplies for manufacturing, governmental and other industrial customers.
